follow_up.method: Positive metadata projection for caption-file offers, transcript references, rendition dimensions/counts, and provided resource-field states
follow_up.metadata_requests_count_scope: Sum of saved per-row attempt counts across original and resumed JSONL records; final-run count reported separately.
follow_up.error_normalization: All nonassignment errors are classified by their actual GraphQL paths. Historical broad assetErrors labels are normalized; unrelated fields do not become asset-field failures.
follow_up.request_evidence_scope: Saved metadata records and the single metadata-only request path support these zero counts; no separate network counter was recorded.

rate_limit_header_evidence.limitation: Historical header values remain unavailable. Resumed attempts preserve selected rate-limit response headers privately; counts describe saved metadata attempts, not separate network instrumentation.

follow_up.resumable_checkpoint: Retained privately; bound to source identities and projection hash. No checkpoint or authenticated request details are published.
follow_up.union_scope: Union of 33 baseline default samples and 1,789 verified positive-projection lessons; excludes the separate URL-only pass. Caption locale and stream-entry counts are method-scoped and are not summed across overlapping samples.

separate_url_only_pass.method: URL-offer-only positive projection for the requested _720 profile
separate_url_only_pass.scope_limit: 877 responses establish progressive/streaming URL offers for this requested profile only; no all-rendition, playback, caption, transcript, or file-integrity conclusion.
separate_url_only_pass.overlap_with_other_methods: Not reconciled for a combined total; these method-scoped counts are not added to the baseline/positive-projection metadata union.

request_history.deduplication: Distinct recorded request starts; identical timestamps retained in canonical controller rows take precedence over archived pilot copies.

pacing.count_scope: Canonical controller rows, archived pilot rows, and discovery probes are counted separately, then deduplicated by recorded request start. Transient historical errors are distinct from final per-identity source gaps.

method.network_scope: Actual captured course and video persisted metadata GETs; no returned URL was followed.
method.course_fields: Replacement fields, public author slug/display name, title/release/update metadata, provided repository/Codespace/external-provider/presentation fields, exercise-file offer metadata, and course-description hyperlinks/literal HTTP(S) URLs.
method.lesson_fields: Structured hyperlink attributes and literal HTTP(S) URLs extracted privately from description text; description text and URL values are excluded from sanitized reports. Extracted strings and structured hyperlinks are candidates, not independently validated course assets.
method.cached_scope: Thirty-three already-observed default-video descriptions retain their original per-course observation times and page-hash provenance. They are not counted as fresh requests.
method.url_detection_limit: Plain-text detection checks literal valid HTTP(S) URLs only. Unstructured bare domains, obfuscated links, non-HTTP plain-text schemes, spoken links, and links inside unqueried course content are outside that detection method. Structured hyperlink metadata may retain non-HTTP schemes in coarse invalid_or_non_http category counts; these are not HTTP URL candidates, and accessibility and relevance remain unverified.
method.relationship_limit: The captured schema exposes replacement fields but no explicit original-audio, translation-family, or version-family fields. Absence from the observed schema does not prove such relationships do not exist elsewhere.
